summary: Verified Observatory zoom controls, D-pad coordinate navigation, populated-cell click routing, and spaceport coordinate auto-fill on the live mobile preview. Backend regression suite passed 4/4.

Coordinate shifting clamps to the 0..46 universe bounds and all four D-pad directions were verified.
No API failures or frontend console/runtime errors were observed during the executed flow.
